title: Meme Disc's
description: Meme Disc's adds disc's that are meme.
body:
Wanna hear memes while playing on your world? Wanna troll friends with meme sound? Here is the right mod for your needs. Meme discs adds 8 discs that have people favorite meme sound also including a Meme Music structure where you can obtain meme disc. You should download Meme Disc's to have ultamite fun and to start collecting!

Meme Music Structure is a store that can spawn anywhere in the overworld that contains the meme discs (the only way to get it in survival)

How to get the disc's in survival: Disc's are in the Meme Music structure which are located anywhere in the overworld (Not underground though)

What type of memes are included in the mod? In meme disc's the memes included in the mod are the skeleton banging and the Fahh and also the diddy blud song.

Note: I will be updating it mostly on weekends and also gonna add it for Neoforge and Forge
